sermon.title: Before and Behind— October 10, 2021
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: From Philippians 3, forget what is behind and reach forward to lay hold of Christ Himself. David’s flight from Absalom shows who cursed, abandoned, befriended and followed the true king. Nicky Cruz and the origin of “I Have Decided to Follow Jesus” illustrate devotion.
